killedBy: boot: the message itself classifies each cause into its own state, and guesses at nothing
boot: nothing starts until the player asks (issue #428) a FATAL cause still replaces the page, even from a menu click
why: Restores the SHIPPED ordering, which issue #325's 2026-09-11 ruling reversed. With the call site checked first, `at === 'match'` short-circuits before the error is examined: a browser with no WebGL 2 that gets as far as a menu click is told 'that match could not start' and handed back a Main Menu whose every Start fails identically. After the ruling that is worse than a wrong message -- the transient state is now a DISMISSIBLE OVERLAY, so the mutation turns a fatal, unrecoverable condition into a dialog the player closes to return to a menu that cannot work. Both halves are killed: the classification case pins the pair directly, and the boot case proves the page still replaces the shell for a fatal cause reached from a click.
